name: Field-Based Citrus Leaf Disease Image Dataset
description: (1) In agriculture, plant diseases are primarily responsible for the reduction in production which causes economic losses. In plants, citrus is used as a major source of nutrients like vitamin C throughout the world. However, ‘Citrus’ diseases badly effect the production and quality of citrus fruits. (2) The computer vision and image processing techniques have been widely used for detection and classification of diseases in plants. (3) The dataset contains an image gallery of healthy and unhealthy citrus fruits and leaves that could be usable for the researchers to prevent plants from diseases using advanced computer vision techniques. The disease targeted in the data sets are the Greasy Spot, Greening, and California Red Scale. (4) All images were acquired from the Fes-Meknes region of Morocco By Wafae Hamdaoui (5) All images were annotated manually by the domain expert Dr. ZAKARIAE BAIZ to represent their every class such as Greasy Spot, Greening, California Red Scale, and healthy with total number of 611 image.
